About Me

Get to know me and my academic journey.

My name is Nathan Uchenna Maduka, and I am a 200-level Software Engineering student. I am interested in information technology, software development, and learning how modern websites and applications are created.

Through my industrial training, I aim to develop practical skills in full stack web development, including designing attractive web pages, programming interactive features, understanding backend development, and working with databases.

My ambition is to become a competent software developer who can build responsive, functional, and user-friendly applications while continually improving my technical knowledge.
